=== other-pipelines.yml (tasks-pipelines)
# Imported from other-pipelines.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: ci
on:
  push: {branches: ['*']}
steps:
  build:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    run: |
      echo top-level steps

--- findings
different tasks.trigger.implied        other-pipelines.yml:1 The old system runs on every branch when a file has no trigger section, so every branch push was written as a trigger -> Narrow the branches if you do not want that
different write.image.default          other-pipelines.yml:1 The steps build name no container image, so they run in docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04 instead of a hosted runner's machine image, which has many tools installed -> Name an image that has the tools the commands need (set image: on the step), or install them in the script
exact     tasks.step.script            other-pipelines.yml:2 Commands carry over; workingDirectory and env wrap that step's commands
